description.value: Blue Ocean Bar & Grill is the full-service restaurant at Blue Ocean Golf Club in Sechelt on the Sunshine Coast, with capacity for up to 110 guests for lunch, dinner, and private events. It has built a reputation as a local favourite, with a dedicated head chef and recurring special events such as Prime Rib Nights and seasonal brunch buffets. The scenic golf course property makes it a worthwhile dining stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.
